Guided practice: Golden Spark Visualization
Purpose: Shift attention from stress toward inner vitality.
Coherence area: Emotional flow.
This is the authored script. Guide it in these words.

Close your eyes.
Notice the stillness between each inhale and exhale.
In the center of your heart, imagine a tiny golden spark.
With every breath, watch it become brighter...
Growing into a warm golden flame.
Allow this light to gently dissolve tension...
Releasing fear...
Softening old patterns...
Let the golden light spread through your chest...
Into your spine...
Through your arms...
Your abdomen...
Your legs...
Until your entire body feels surrounded by a quiet golden glow.
Rest here for a few breaths.
Breathe in.
Breathe out.
Repeat the cycle 3 times.

Guided practice: Microcosm → Macrocosm Breath
Purpose: Expand awareness beyond the self and cultivate a sense of connection.
Coherence area: Connection.
This is the authored script. Guide it in these words.

Close your eyes and breathe slowly.
As you inhale, imagine your nervous system as a tiny universe—a living microcosm filled with light, intelligence, and possibility.
Breathe in.
Breathe out: As you exhale, allow that light to expand beyond your body...
Breathe in.
Breathe out: Filling the room...
Breathe in.
Breathe out: Flowing beyond the walls...
Breathe in.
Breathe out: Expanding into the vast universe—the macrocosm.
With every breath, remember:
The light within you is not small or separate. It is connected to something infinitely greater.
Rest in that feeling for several slow breaths.
Breathe in.
Breathe out.
Repeat the cycle 4 times.

Guided practice: Presence of Light
Purpose: Cultivate presence and inner stillness.
Coherence area: Presence.
This is the authored script. Guide it in these words.

For the next few moments, don't search for answers.
Simply experience being.
Slowly repeat:
I am here.
I am whole.
I am light.
After each phrase, notice what happens inside your body.
Does your breathing soften?
Does your chest feel more open?
Do you notice even the smallest feeling of peace or expansion?
There is nothing to force.
Simply allow yourself to experience this moment exactly as it is.

Guided practice: One Minute Together (placeholder)
Purpose: Placeholder pending Dr. Mia's authored copy.
Coherence area: Overall.
This is the authored script. Guide it in these words.

Let's take one minute together.
Breathe in: Breathe in through your nose
Hold: Hold
Breathe out: Out slowly through your mouth
Repeat the cycle 4 times.
Let your shoulders drop.

Guided practice: Solar Plexus Light
Purpose: Strengthen feelings of agency, confidence, and embodied awareness.
Coherence area: Energy.
This is the authored script. Guide it in these words.

Place one hand over your solar plexus, just above your navel.
Feel the warmth beneath your hand.
Imagine a radiant sun shining there.
Breathe in: With each inhale, its light becomes brighter.
Breathe out: With every exhale, that light travels throughout your nervous system...
Breathe in.
Breathe out: Flowing through your chest...
Breathe in.
Breathe out: Down your spine...
Breathe in.
Breathe out: Into your shoulders...
Breathe in.
Breathe out: Arms...
Breathe in.
Breathe out: Hands...
Breathe in.
Breathe out: Legs...
Breathe in.
Breathe out: Feet...
Illuminating every cell.
As you breathe, quietly repeat:
The light I seek already lives within me.
Rest in that awareness.

Guided practice: Sovereignty Reflection
Purpose: Reduce unnecessary struggle and return to inner steadiness.
Coherence area: Choice.
This is the authored script. Guide it in these words.

Breathe in: Take one slow breath.
Breathe out.
Ask yourself:
What can I let go of right now so my inner light can shine more freely?
Wait quietly for whatever arises.
It may be a fear...
A need to be right...
A resentment...
A worry...
Or simply the urge to keep fighting.
You don't need to solve anything in this moment.
Simply notice it.
Breathe in: Breathe.
Breathe out.
Then choose peace over struggle.
Allow yourself to return to the quiet strength already within you.

Guided practice: 30-Second Reset
Purpose: Close a study block and come back to your body before the next one.
This is the authored script. Guide it in these words.

Breath
Stretch
Relax shoulders
Jaw
Eyes
Back to work.

Coherence area: Authentic expression.
The daily check-in asks: How free do you feel to express your true self today?
After a regulation exercise it asks: How free do you feel to express yourself now?
When the score is low, Cal guides: A brief reflection on what feels held back, and an invitation to one small authentic action.

Coherence area: Body awareness.
The daily check-in asks: How connected do you feel to your body right now?
After a regulation exercise it asks: How connected do you feel now?
When the score is low, Cal guides: Gently wiggle your fingers and toes, notice your feet on the floor, and reconnect with physical sensation.

Coherence area: Breath.
The daily check-in asks: How freely is your breath moving into your heart and belly right now?
After a regulation exercise it asks: How does your breath feel now?
When the score is low, Cal guides: Embodied Vital Breathwork™.

Coherence area: Choice.
The daily check-in asks: How much do you feel you are responding by choice instead of reacting automatically?
After a regulation exercise it asks: How much choice do you feel now?
When the score is low, Cal guides: A pause-and-reflect exercise.

Coherence area: Connection.
The daily check-in asks: How connected do you feel to yourself and to the people around you today?
After a regulation exercise it asks: How connected do you feel now?
When the score is low, Cal guides: A simple connection practice.

Coherence area: Emotional flow.
The daily check-in asks: How freely are your emotions moving without feeling stuck or overwhelming?
After a regulation exercise it asks: How does your emotional flow feel now?
When the score is low, Cal guides: Emotional regulation through breath, awareness, and allowing.

Coherence area: Energy.
The daily check-in asks: How much healthy energy is available to you right now?
After a regulation exercise it asks: How energized do you feel now?
When the score is low, Cal guides: Posture, breathing, and gentle movement.

Coherence area: Inner knowing.
The daily check-in asks: How clearly can you hear and trust your inner knowing right now?
After a regulation exercise it asks: How connected do you feel to your inner knowing now?
When the score is low, Cal guides: A short quiet reflection.

Coherence area: Overall.
The daily check-in asks: How do you feel right here in the moment?
After a regulation exercise it asks: How do you feel now?
When the score is low, Cal guides: Guided breathing.

Coherence area: Presence.
The daily check-in asks: How present do you feel right here in this moment?
After a regulation exercise it asks: How present do you feel now?
When the score is low, Cal guides: A mindfulness exercise using the senses.

Coherence area: Safety.
The daily check-in asks: How safe does your body feel as a place to live right now?
After a regulation exercise it asks: How safe does your body feel now?
When the score is low, Cal guides: A grounding exercise and slow breathing.
